articles.title: Live markets: Bitcoin gives up all of May's gains, slipping below $77,000
articles.snippet: Strategy made a mammoth $2 billion bitcoin purchase last week, but it's not lifting crypto spirits or prices.

articles.title: Kraken parent Payward's Q1 revenue climbs despite crypto market slump
articles.snippet: Co-CEO Arjun Sethi said the firm kept investing through market weakness, leaning on acquisitions and futures growth to offset softer spot trading.

articles.title: Iran may be turning the Strait of Hormuz into a bitcoin-based insurance market, local reports say
articles.snippet: State-linked Fars News reported that Iran’s economy ministry has been working on a plan to manage shipping through the Strait with payments in bitcoin.

articles.title: Crypto funds see $1B in outflows as Iran tensions revive risk-off sentiment
articles.snippet: Institutional investors pulled capital from Bitcoin and Ether products as Iran tension and rising inflation rattled markets, while XRP and Solana funds continued to attract fresh inflows.

articles.title: Standard Chartered to absorb Zodia Custody’s core business, spin out Zodia Solutions
articles.snippet: Standard Chartered will absorb Zodia Custody’s regulated crypto business and spin out Zodia Solutions, as big banks move to own core digital asset custody in-house.
